verdict.rationale: Fivetran publishes an official MCP server in its own GitHub org (fivetran/fivetran-mcp), confirmed by a probe. It lets an agent ask read-only questions about connection and sync status, and it can unlock write and delete operations through FIVETRAN_SCOPE, guarded by a credential-endpoint denylist (DISALLOWED_ACTIONS). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agent connections, and documented setup steps for specific MCP clients and hosting options.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: official MCP server documented at https://github.com/fivetran/fivetran-mcp
It allows you to ask read-only questions like "when was the last time my postgres connection completed a sync?" and "are any of my connections broken?"
Set `FIVETRAN_SCOPE` to `read/write` or `read/write/delete` to unlock write and delete operations
